title: Concept: GraphQL field suggestion disclosed
description: A GraphQL suggestion list in an error response in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The suggestion list names fields that exist but were not queried, so an attacker can walk the schema one typo at a time even when introspection is disabled.
applicability: GraphQL endpoints reachable by customers or partners.
risk: A derived schema reveals internal fields, including administrative mutations that should not be discoverable.
